Name: Keep Out (Chests and Gates)
Author: adverserath
Description:
[size=5][b]Keep Out Chests[/b][/size]

A mod that lets you [b]lock chests and gates[/b] so other players in multiplayer can't open, break, or steal from them.
Perfect for shared farms where you want a personal chest that stays yours, or a fenced-off area only you can pass through.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[url=https://github.com/adverserath/KeepOutChests#features][/url]
[list]
[*][b]Lock any chest or fence gate[/b] you own with a single key combo.[/*]
[*][b]Locked chests are protected[/b] from non-owners:
[list]
[*]Can't be opened.[/*]
[*]Can't be broken with a tool (pickaxe, axe, etc.).[/*]
[*]Can't have items inserted into them.[/*]
[*]Are excluded from workbench / crafting menus, so their contents can't be used as crafting materials.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Locked gates protect the whole fence line.[/b] Locking a gate blocks non-owners from opening it [i]or[/i] destroying any fence connected to it.[/*]
[*][b]Visual lock overlay[/b] drawn on locked chests and gates so everyone can see what's off-limits.[/*]
[*][b]Ownership is automatic.[/b] The first player to open (or lock) an unclaimed chest becomes its owner.[/*]
[*][b]Owner notifications.[/b] You get a HUD message when another player tries to access your locked chest.[/*]
[*][b]Full multiplayer sync.[/b] Ownership and lock state are kept consistent between the host and all farmhands, including for players who join after a chest was locked.[/*]
[*][b]Custom lock/unlock sounds[/b] and HUD feedback ("Locked" / "Unlocked").[/*]
[/list][heading]How to use[/heading]
[url=https://github.com/adverserath/KeepOutChests#how-to-use][/url]
Claiming a chest
[url=https://github.com/adverserath/KeepOutChests#claiming-a-chest][/url]
Simply [b]opening an unowned chest[/b] claims it for you (unlocked). Once you own it, you can lock it at any time.
Locking / unlocking
[url=https://github.com/adverserath/KeepOutChests#locking--unlocking][/url]
Hold the [b]modifier key[/b] and press the [b]action button[/b] on a chest or gate to toggle its lock:
[table][tr][th]Input[/th]
[th]Default modifier[/th]
[th]Action button[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Keyboard / mouse[/td]
[td][code]Left Shift[/code][/td]
[td]Right-click[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Controller[/td]
[td][code]Left Shoulder[/code](LB)[/td]
[td][code]A[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][list]
[*]Locking a chest also claims it if it's unowned.[/*]
[*]A chest [b]must be empty[/b] and not currently in use before it can be locked.[/*]
[*]Gates can be locked at any time and don't need to be emptied.[/*]
[*]Only the owner can toggle a lock or break/move a locked object.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[url=https://github.com/adverserath/KeepOutChests#installation][/url]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.8 or later).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]In multiplayer, [b]every player should have the mod installed[/b] for locks to be respected on their client.

Manifest.Name: Keep Out Chests
Manifest.Description: Lock chests and gates to prevent other players from accessing or destroying them. Hold a tool on a chest for 1 second to toggle the lock.
